Lisa Bryant

12-22-23
Claimant reported a left-turn collision at an intersection with a vehicle that did not yield, and stated a shoulder injury
resulted. Claimant is not represented by counsel and was cooperative during the initial call.
2-8-24
Reviewed photos of the claimant's vehicle, which show front-end damage consistent with the impact described. The
damage pattern lines up well with the force of a collision of this type.
2-11-24
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and that the other driver turned
across the claimant's path. The other driver's account matches the claimant's description of how the collision
occurred.
6-26-24
Claimant has given the same account of the accident in each conversation so far, with no changes to the sequence of
events or the point of impact. No prior damage to the vehicle is recorded or known to the claimant.
7-18-24
Medical records show treatment for the shoulder injury has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. No
earlier inujry to the same body area has been identified in the claimant's history or prior claims.
8-11-24
Verified that the driver is named on the policy and that nothing indicates the vehicle damage predates the coverage
start. Injury evaluation remains open pending the treating provider's updated notes.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
